title: Career Roadmap · Machinist
summary: A Machinist operates and maintains machine tools to manufacture precision components from metal and other materials using engineering drawings, measurements and machining processes.

facts.Course: Fitter / Turner / Machinist / Tool & Die Maker

blocks.text: Primary training pathway
ITI Machinist, with Fitter, Turner or Tool & Die Maker as related mechanical trades.
Core work
Lathe operation • Milling • Drilling • Precision measurement • Component finishing • Quality inspection

blocks.label: Recommended qualification
blocks.text: Class 10 with Mathematics and Science is a common entry route for ITI Machinist; verify the specific trade's current eligibility.

blocks.label: Alternative
blocks.text: Class 12 Science or a relevant vocational qualification can support diploma and advanced technical pathways.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-level admission, depending on the institution and scheme.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Workshop practice, metalworking, engineering drawings, machine tools and industrial safety.

blocks.label: Early skills

blocks.label: Year 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Workshop safety, engineering drawing, hand tools, measurement and basic fitting.

blocks.label: Year 2 — Machining skills
blocks.text: Lathe, milling, drilling, grinding, precision measurement and component finishing.

blocks.label: Advanced practice
blocks.text: CNC fundamentals, machine setup, tool selection, tolerances, quality inspection and preventive maintenance.

blocks.label: Career preparation
blocks.text: Practical trade test, apprenticeship applications, technical interview preparation and a record of completed machining jobs.

blocks.label: Practice projects
blocks.text: Turn a stepped shaft • Machine a threaded component • Produce a component to drawing tolerances • Measure and inspect a precision part.
*The standard DGT Machinist Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) is listed as a two-year, 2,400-hour trade, with Class 10 Science and Mathematics or an accepted equivalent as the entry qualification.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Relevant school or trade qualifications, practical experience where required, language proficiency, transcripts and proof of funds for international study. Recognition of an Indian ITI certificate varies by country and institution.
